description: This file exports types, functions, and constants related to real-time transcription providers in a plugin architecture, primarily acting as an index or aggregation of exports from multiple modules.

methods.name: canonicalizeRealtimeTranscriptionProviderId
methods.description: Normalizes a real-time transcription provider ID to a canonical form.
